collection.title: Toyota Yaris/Vitz Japanese Build 2011 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Yaris Japanese Build 2011 - 2019 requires a 28" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Yaris which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
